# Akman--Sissokho Steiner paper record

Source: Fusun Akman and Papa A. Sissokho, *Steiner Coset Partitions of
Groups*, Canadian Mathematical Bulletin 68 (2025), no. 4, 1359--1373.

DOI: https://doi.org/10.4153/S0008439525100787

Publisher online date: 2025-06-24. The publisher supplies a calendar date but
no time or time zone, so no UTC or JST time is inferred.

Reviewed: 2026-08-03 JST (UTC+09:00).

The paper studies Steiner and transversal partitions under structural
conditions and recalls the arbitrary-group result through seven distinct
subgroups. It does not state an unconditional arbitrary-group theorem for
eight through seventeen cells.
